title: Federal Reserve Board data (Data Download Program releases, Z.1 Financial Accounts, Survey of Consumer Finances)
agency: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
questions: total consumer credit outstanding, latest month
household and nonprofit net worth from the Financial Accounts (B.101)
median family net worth by age or race in the 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances
share of banks tightening standards on commercial and industrial loans (SLOOS)
who holds Treasury securities by sector (Z.1)

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save the file under the name shown, then upload it. A Data Download Program (DDP) link given by package title opens the release's Choose page (https://www.federalreserve.gov/datadownload/Choose.aspx?rel=<release>): pick that preformatted package, click Format package, keep CSV, then Download file. Z.1 tables: https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/z1/current/z1_csv_files.zip (upload the zip, or the one table CSV from its csv/ folder). SCF: https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/scfindex.htm (interactive chart data scf.zip, summary tables workbook).

cache.why: Releases update weekly to quarterly (SCF every three years); data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: Board website terms (https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm): information on the Board's website is in the public domain unless otherwise indicated and may be copied and distributed without permission; cite the Board as the source.

citation: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, {dataset}, federalreserve.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Seasonally adjusted or not? G.19 publishes both; the headline is seasonally adjusted. Default: seasonally adjusted where it exists, named in the answer.
Levels (amounts outstanding) or flows (transactions, often at seasonally adjusted annual rates)? Default: levels.
SCF dollars: survey-year (nominal) or inflation-adjusted 2025 dollars? Default: 2025 dollars for comparisons across surveys, nominal for one survey year.
